date-tvdb.reason: TVDB carries the 4Kids dub titles and AniDB the Japanese ones, so the pairs share no words; I matched them through the Wikipedia list of Sonic X episodes, which gives the Japanese number, the Japanese title and the dub title: Japanese 1 "Enter Supersonic Hedgehog" = dub "Chaos Control Freaks" = S1E1, 2 "Infiltrate! Area 99" = "Sonic to the Rescue" = S1E2, 28 "The Mysterious Lifeform, Chaos" = "A Chaotic Day" = S2E2, 29 "Amy the Captive" = "A Robot Rebels" = S2E3, 53 "A Messenger From A Meteor Shower" = "A Cosmic Call" = S3E1, 54 "The Spaceship: Blue Typhoon" = "Cosmic Crisis" = S3E2, 76 "Decisive Battle! Dark Oak" = "The Light in the Darkness" = S3E24, 78 "The Place Where Planets Are Born" = "So Long, Sonic" = S3E26. All 78 numbers line up with the 78 TVDB episodes in order (26+26+26). The one failure, AniDB 53 dated 2005-04-16 (AniDB 54-78 carry no date, so this one is a stray date; the Wikipedia list gives 2020 dates for the whole season), points at S3E23-25 whose dub titles ("Agent of Mischief", "The Light in the Darkness", "A Fearless Friend") are Japanese 75-77.
